name: dod-architect
description: Author a Definition of Done (DoD) grounded in whatever source material actually exists — documents, transcripts, tickets, existing code, or a prior PRD — rather than a fixed input taxonomy. Mines the sources for architecture-shaping constraints (not just behavior) and pairs each with a concrete design implication, labeled by provenance relationship (Source / Derived from / Must not break). Produces a Markdown DoD, optionally rendered to Google Docs.

interface.longDescription: Author or enrich a Definition of Done from documents, transcripts, tickets, existing code, or a prior PRD. Extract architecture-shaping constraints and acceptance criteria with honest source provenance so engineers can design against real needs. Produces Markdown; optional Google Docs rendering requires Python 3 and authenticated gws. Architecture design is a separate step.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a Definition of Done from the source material I provide, with design context and source-backed acceptance criteria.
